OPTION_GU_ZHEN_REN_GU_RANK_UP.name: Gu Refinement
OPTION_GU_ZHEN_REN_GU_RANK_UP.descriptio: First select 1 eligible Gu Worm. If it is mortal, you may select up to 2 additional mortal Gu Worms (3 total); if it is immortal, you may select up to 1 additional immortal Gu Worm (2 total). Each selected Gu Worm gains one rank, including rank 5 to rank 6. Confirming with 0 selected cancels. Each rest site allows one successful refinement.
OPTION_GU_ZHEN_REN_GU_RANK_UP.selectionP: Select the first Gu Worm to refine. Then select up to 2 more of the same kind; mortal Gu can total 3 and immortal Gu can total 2.
OPTION_GU_ZHEN_REN_HE_LIAN.name: Gu Fusion
OPTION_GU_ZHEN_REN_HE_LIAN.description: First select a currently craftable Gu card, then select Gu Worm materials matching that target. Materials are consumed and the result is created only when both types and quantities match; failed attempts do not consume the use. Fusion can succeed once per rest site.
OPTION_GU_ZHEN_REN_HE_LIAN.selectionProm: Select materials matching the target Gu card, then confirm.
OPTION_GU_ZHEN_REN_HE_LIAN.targetSelecti: First select the Gu card to craft. Only materials that can match the target will be shown next.
OPTION_GU_ZHEN_REN_GU_RANK_UP.secondMort: Select additional Gu Worms of the same kind (up to 2 mortal or 1 immortal), or confirm with 0 selected.
